scope: Preserve the bridge's shared _work_lease/work_boundary helper and enforce the canonical delivery/terminal fence through that same helper. Add only source_readbacks propagation to managed.py and dispatch.py, with no public schema change. Actual provider reads remain outside Core transactions; a post-initialization failure takes the existing abort/stop reconciliation.

case_added.basis: Lead integration direction; R07/R11 and the existing work-boundary atomicity contract
case_added.precondition: An owned running Core attempt has valid task status/decision/resources; a provider-backed historical delivered observation sets the canonical fence before a short effect without rewriting the task's current status.
case_added.actions: Record the actual authored provider observation, then invoke both validate_work_lease and work_boundary; place a local publication inside the latter body.
case_added.expected: Both paths consult the same current canonical fence and raise InvalidTransition before work/publication. The local publication is absent and unresolved owned leases remain retained. No claim of a live host or distributed provider lock.
